checklist: uv --version prints 'uv 0.1.0-6 (@ai-ecoverse/wasix-uv-shim)' and the stderr note that it is a shim over pip, not Astral's uv
homescoop#103 done-when: uv venv && uv pip install requests && uv run python -c 'import requests' (sys.prefix is the venv)
requests is in the venv only: base python cannot import it; uv pip list/freeze show it; uv pip uninstall removes it
uv pip with no venv: 'No virtual environment found', rc 2
uv init; uv add idna charset-normalizer writes dependencies with installed lower bounds (idna>=3.20) and syncs
uv run of a dependency's console script (normalizer --version) and of main.py
rm -rf .venv && uv sync rebuilds the environment from pyproject.toml
uv remove drops the dependency from pyproject.toml and the venv
uv add outside a project: 'No `pyproject.toml` found', rc 2
unsupported (lock, tool, python install, build, pip compile): rc 2, message names the shim
network: The cert kernel has no network: the spec fetches pinned wheels (sha256-checked) and pip installs them with PIP_NO_INDEX/PIP_FIND_LINKS. PyPI over the kernel's CONNECT proxy was checked by hand on the Node entry with a fetch transport.
